title: Care Management Monthly Contact and Quarterly Visit Minimums
content:
In Care Management each tier sets the fewest successful care team contacts per calendar month, the fewest in-person or home visits per calendar quarter, and the contact modes that count toward the monthly minimum.

| Care Management tier | Successful contacts per calendar month, at least | In-person or home visits per calendar quarter, at least | Contact modes that count toward the monthly minimum |
|---|---|---|---|
| Healthy Living Support | 0 | 0 | Phone, video, text |
| Care Coordination Level 1 | 1 | 0 | Phone, video, in person, home visit |
| Care Coordination Level 2 | 2 | 1 | Phone, video, in person, home visit |
| Maternal Care Management | 2 | 1 | Phone, video, in person, home visit |
| Complex Case Management | 4 | 1 | Phone, video, in person, home visit |
| Health Home Services | 1 | 1 | Phone, video, in person, home visit |
| LTSS Service Coordination | 1 | 1 | Phone, video, in person, home visit |

## Distinctions between the tiers

- Text is a counted contact mode only in Healthy Living Support; in every other tier the counted modes are phone, video, in person and home visit.
- Complex Case Management has the highest monthly figure, 4 successful contacts.
- Care Coordination Level 1 has a monthly minimum of 1 and no quarterly visit minimum; every tier from Care Coordination Level 2 onward in the table has a quarterly minimum of 1 in-person or home visit.

## Tallying a month (hypothetical contacts)

A hypothetical Care Coordination Level 2 member has, in one calendar month, a successful phone contact and a successful text contact. Text is not a counted mode for that tier, so the month shows 1 counted contact against a minimum of 2. The same two contacts for a Healthy Living Support member would both be in counted modes.

A hypothetical Maternal Care Management member whose only contacts in a quarter were phone and video calls has no in-person or home visit in that quarter, against a quarterly minimum of 1.
